handoff.decision: The two sampled contacts match the declared 0.18 m sphere against saved geometry. They indicate policy/navigation failures, with distinct sampled modes: late offset-doorway alignment and severe high-rate tracking loss that causes floor contact. A half-scale diagnostic removes the latter floor impact in one scene but still contacts a doorway panel; do not treat global slowdown as a fix.

cases.result: contact at 1.97 s on doorway edge; 0.116 m minimum pooled ray at prior 1.95 s policy frame, followed by 0.997 m/s forward body command; center had not reached opening's 0.18 m safe interval

body-rate norm first exceeds 5 rad/s at 3.27 s, altitude falls below 0.5 m at 5.31 s, and floor contact occurs at 6.56 s with 3.098 m/s world speed, about 17.3 rad/s body-rate norm and about 3.65 m/s target-tracking error
success at 10.51 s; instrumentation replay matched saved result
slower, peak speed 1.085 m/s, but contact on solid first-partition panel at 5.41 s
body-rate norm stays below 5 rad/s until 12.20 s, minimum altitude is 1.102 m and peak speed 1.351 m/s, but contact on solid second-partition panel at 12.40 s

handoff.minimal_next_trace_contract: A Metal cold path must accept one exact saved DEV scene and deployed actor, then export synchronized 100 Hz world position/velocity/quaternion/body rates/target/motor state and 20 Hz actor observation/action, each with step number and simulation time. Current per-episode Metal CSV cannot align policy/plant divergence with these Webots contact events.
